target.title: fix(qqbot): log tool media failures after block replies
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

When QQBot had already delivered a block reply and later flushed tool-collected
media URLs, `outbound-dispatch.ts` wrapped `sendMedia` in an empty `catch {}`
and ignored `result.error`. Upload/send failures were silent: the turn looked
successful while tool images/files never reached the user.

The tool-only fallback path already logged via `sendToolMediaWithTimeout`,
which closes over and forwards `...gatewayMediaContext` (workspaceDir /
mediaAccess) into `sendMedia`.

## Why This Change Was Made

Reuse `sendToolMediaWithTimeout` for the post-block tool-media flush so thrown
failures and `result.error` are logged with the same timeout/budget behavior
and the same `gatewayMediaContext` forwarding as the tool-only path.

## User Impact

**Before:** Tool media after a visible block reply could fail with no log.

**After:** Failures are logged
(`Tool media send error after block response: …`) while agent-scoped local
media roots still resolve through `gatewayMediaContext`.

## Evidence

- Changed: `extensions/qqbot/src/engine/gateway/outbound-dispatch.ts`,
  `extensions/qqbot/src/engine/gateway/outbound-dispatch.test.ts`
- Production path: `deliver(block)` → `deliver(tool mediaUrl)` →
  `hasBlockResponse && toolMediaUrls` → `sendToolMediaWithTimeout` →
  `sendMedia({ ...gatewayMediaContext })` → `log.error` on failure

## Real behavior proof

### Behavior or issue addressed

1. Rejected post-block `sendMedia` is logged (no empty catch).
2. Agent-scoped local tool media after a block still resolves to the workspace
   file path (proves `gatewayMediaContext` is still forwarded by the helper).
3. The same local-root path also logs when the send rejects.

### Canonical reachability path

`dispatchOutbound` → buffered block deliver → tool media deliver →
`sendToolMediaWithTimeout` (closes over `gatewayMediaContext`) →
`sendMedia` / `log.error`

### Shared helper / provider constraint check

Reuses existing `sendToolMediaWithTimeout` (already spreads
`...gatewayMediaContext` on every call). No send-contract narrowing.

### Real environment tested

Local trusted checkout; production `dispatchOutbound` caller with real temp
workspace file + mocked sender reject. Node v22.23.1; PR head `3c7b10c8ea9`.

### Exact steps or command run after this patch

```bash
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/qqbot/src/engine/gateway/outbound-dispatch.test.ts -t "logs tool media|keeps agent-scoped media roots on post-block|threads agent scoped media roots through gateway tool media" --reporter=verbose
```

### Evidence after fix

```text
✓ threads agent scoped media roots through gateway tool media forwarding 40ms
✓ logs tool media send failures after a block response instead of swallowing them 16ms
✓ keeps agent-scoped media roots on post-block tool media while logging send errors 21ms
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  3 passed | 42 skipped (45)
```

### Observed result after fix

- `log.error` receives
  `Tool media send error after block response: upload exploded`.
- Post-block local tool media still calls sender with
  `source: { localPath: <realpath under agent workspace> }` (context preserved)
  and still logs on reject.

### What was not tested

Live QQ Bot API upload against a real account. Proof is the production
`dispatchOutbound` path with a real workspace file and mocked transport reject.

### Fix classification

bugfix — silent media delivery failure

## AI Assistance

AI-assisted implementation and proof.
